name: RndTrade
summary: RndTrade is an Expert Advisor that executes trades based on random entry signals, essentially a randomized trading system. It opens buy or sell positions with no directional bias, relying on probability and risk management rather than technical or fundamental analysis. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to test whether risk management alone can produce profitable results without any predictive edge.
summary_zh: RndTrade是一个基于随机入场信号执行交易的EA，本质上是一个随机化交易系统。它以无方向偏好开立多头或空头头寸，依赖概率和风险管理而非技术或基本面分析。该EA作为实验或基准工具，测试仅靠风险管理是否能在没有任何预测优势的情况下产生盈利结果。
strategy_analysis: RndTrade的策略概念完全基于随机性，入场条件由随机数生成器决定，随机选择买入或卖出方向，没有任何技术指标或价格行为分析作为依据。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈水平，或者可能使用追踪止损来管理已开仓位。仓位管理方面，EA可能提供固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理是该EA唯一的核心优势，因为随机入场本身没有统计优势，盈利完全取决于良好的风险回报比和仓位控制。整体而言，这是一个概念验证型EA，用于验证'随机入场+严格风险管理'是否能长期存活，实际交易中缺乏任何可重复的统计优势。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of RndTrade is entirely based on randomness, with entry conditions determined by a random number generator that randomly selects buy or sell direction without any technical indicator or price action analysis. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, or possibly a trailing stop mechanism to manage open positions. For position sizing, the EA likely offers fixed lot size or balance-proportional lot calculation. Money management is the only core strength of this EA, since random entry itself carries no statistical edge, and profitability depends entirely on favorable risk-reward ratios and position control. Overall, this is a proof-of-concept EA designed to test whether 'random entry + strict risk management' can survive long-term, but it lacks any repeatable statistical advantage in actual trading.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 无偏见入场，避免了交易者情绪和主观判断带来的错误决策
强制执行严格的风险管理规则，止损止盈明确，不会因情绪而移动止损
作为基准工具非常有价值，可以用来评估其他策略是否真正具有超越随机入场的统计优势
pros_en: Unbiased entry eliminates emotional and subjective decision-making errors that traders commonly make
Enforces strict risk management rules with clear stop loss and take profit, preventing emotional stop adjustments
Valuable as a benchmark tool to evaluate whether other strategies genuinely possess a statistical edge over random entry
cons: 随机入场没有任何统计优势，长期期望值为负（考虑点差和佣金后必亏）
缺乏市场状态判断，无论趋势还是震荡行情都采用相同逻辑，无法适应市场变化
无法通过优化参数来改善表现，因为核心逻辑本身就是非预测性的
cons_en: Random entry provides no statistical edge, and long-term expected value is negative after accounting for spreads and commissions
Lacks market state assessment, applying the same logic regardless of trending or ranging conditions, unable to adapt to market changes
Cannot improve performance through parameter optimization since the core logic is inherently non-predictive
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，在趋势行情中增加方向性偏向而非完全随机
加入动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR或波动率调整盈亏比而非使用固定值
improvements_en: Add a market state filter to introduce directional bias during trending markets rather than remaining purely random
Implement dynamic stop loss and take profit based on ATR or volatility instead of fixed pip values

risk_points: 随机入场本身无统计优势，在点差和佣金成本下长期必然亏损
若未加入新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
risk_points_en: Random entry itself has no statistical edge, guaranteeing long-term losses after spread and commission costs
Without new bar check, the EA may repeatedly open positions on the same bar leading to over-trading

It opens buy or sell positions with no directional bias, relying on probability and risk management rather than technical or fundamental analysis. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to test whether risk management alone can produce profitable results without any predictive edge.
